mapper.select: SELECT u.userIdx, u.userId, u.name, u.nickname, u.email, u.tel, u.status, u.createdDate, u.lastLoginDate, u.updatedDate, TO_CHAR(u.birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS birth, u.profile_photo, u.score, u.userLevel, u.batonpoint, u.baton_distance AS batonDistance, u.pwdFailCount, a.authority FROM users u LEFT JOIN userAuthority a ON u.userId = a.userId WHERE u.userIdx = #{userIdx}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET status = #{status, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, updatedDate = SYSDATE WHERE userIdx = #{userIdx, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
UPDATE users SET userLevel = #{userLevel} WHERE userId = #{userId}
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rn, t.* FROM ( SELECT s.sanctionIdx, s.userIdx, s.reason, s.sanctionType, TO_CHAR(s.startDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDate, TO_CHAR(s.endDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endDate, TO_CHAR(s.createdDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdDate, s.isLifted, s.liftReason, u.userId, u.nickname, u.email FROM adminSanction s JOIN users u ON s.userIdx = u.userIdx
AND (u.userId LIKE '%' || #{kwd} || '%' OR u.nickname LIKE '%' || #{kwd} || '%')
AND s.isLifted = 0 AND s.isLifted = 1 AND s.sanctionType = 'PERMANENT' AND s.isLifted = 0
ORDER BY s.createdDate DESC ) t WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{pageSize} ) WHERE rn > #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adminSanction s JOIN users u ON s.userIdx = u.userIdx
AND (u.userId LIKE '%' || #{kwd} || '%' OR u.nickname LIKE '%' || #{kwd} || '%')
AND s.isLifted = 0 AND s.isLifted = 1 AND s.sanctionType = 'PERMANENT' AND s.isLifted = 0
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO adminSanction ( sanctionIdx, userIdx, reason, sanctionType, startDate, endDate, createdDate, isLifted ) VALUES ( adminSanction_seq.NEXTVAL, #{userIdx}, #{reason}, #{sanctionType}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
NULL CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + #{days} , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE withdrawRequest SET withdrawStatus = #{withdrawStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, processDate = SYSDATE WHERE withdrawIdx = #{withdrawIdx, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
UPDATE adminSanction SET isLifted = 1, liftReason = '회원 목록에서 관리자 직권 해제', liftDate = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE userIdx = #{userIdx} AND isLifted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT t.TRADEIDX AS "tradeIdx", t.TRADESTATUS AS "tradeStatus", TO_CHAR(t.TRADEDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "tradeDate", t.TRADEPRICE AS "tradePrice", t.BUYERIDX AS "buyerIdx", t.SELLERIDX AS "sellerIdx", p.title AS "productTitle", b.nickname AS "buyerNickname", b.userId AS "buyerId", s.nickname AS "sellerNickname", s.userId AS "sellerId" FROM TRADETRANSACTION t LEFT JOIN product p ON t.PRODUCTIDX = p.productIdx JOIN users b ON t.BUYERIDX = b.USERIDX JOIN users s ON t.SELLERIDX = s.USERIDX WHERE (t.BUYERIDX = #{userIdx} OR t.SELLERIDX = #{userIdx}) AND t.TRADESTATUS NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED') ORDER BY t.TRADEDATE DESC

SELECT r.reportIdx AS "reportIdx", r.domainType AS "domainType", r.reportType AS "reportType", r.reportContent AS "reportContent", TO_CHAR(r.reportDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "reportDate", u.nickname AS "reporterNickname", u.userId AS "reporterId" FROM adminReport r JOIN users u ON r.reporterIdx = u.userIdx WHERE r.reportedUserIdx = #{userIdx} AND r.processStatus = 0 ORDER BY r.reportDate DESC
